about.heading: Fountainhead School Kunkni
about.intro: Fountainhead School Kunkni is India's 4th ranked co-ed day school (Cfore 2026). Located on Rander-Dandi Road, Surat, the campus runs the full IB continuum from Early Years through Diploma Programme. Head of School: Bhumika Parmar. Senior School Principals: Shezin Siganporia and Utsav Oza.

leaders.name: Bhumika Parmar
leaders.bio: At FSK since 2009 — Home Room Teacher, Team Leader, MYP Coordinator, and now Head of School. Degrees in Commerce, Law, Education, and School Leadership Management. Led curriculum development in the Middle Years. Her view of education goes beyond academic results — it accounts for the person the student becomes.

leaders.name: Shezin Siganporia
leaders.bio: Chartered Accountant. At FS since 2013. Teaches Business Management, brings the same rigour to the classroom that the qualification demands. Passionate about finance and the way it connects to the real world — she makes that connection visible to students.

leaders.name: Utsav Oza
leaders.bio: Engineer. Gold medalist, SCET. Dewang Mehta IT Award 2017. National quiz competitor. Has performed at IIT-Bombay's Mood Indigo. At FS because the job of being curious alongside young people suits him — and because curiosity, he thinks, is what schools are actually for.

academics.heading: Academic Programmes at FSK

programmes.title: Early Years Programme
programmes.body: Play-based inquiry. The environment is the third teacher. Children lead — adults listen and extend.

programmes.title: Primary Years Programme
programmes.body: Six transdisciplinary units of inquiry per year. Concepts, not content. The whole child, not just the academic one.

programmes.title: Middle Years Programme
programmes.body: Eight subject groups. Global contexts that connect what students learn to why it matters. Service as action — not a checkbox.

programmes.title: IB Diploma Programme
programmes.body: University preparation recognised by institutions worldwide. Six subjects, Theory of Knowledge, Extended Essay, CAS. A rigorous two years.

programmes.title: Maverick Learning Centre
programmes.body: Award-winning skill development initiative — Best Skill Development at ScooNews 2023. Inclusive, personalised learning support.

programmes.title: BTec Programme
programmes.body: Industry-aligned vocational qualifications accepted by universities worldwide. Career-ready skills alongside the IB pathway.

academics.learningModelQuote: Learning is not a performance for school. It is a habit that lasts a lifetime — or it is nothing.
academics.learningModelText1: Students are at the centre. Not in theory — in practice. The teacher's job is to build a learner, not deliver a syllabus. Every lesson at FSK is designed around a question, not an answer.
academics.learningModelText2: Academic rigour. Physical fitness. Social and emotional wellbeing. All three, in balance.

myths.myth: IB is only for gifted students
myths.fact: The IB is designed for all learners. Inquiry works for every child — it does not sort them into gifted and not gifted, it asks all of them to think.

myths.myth: IB students cannot do engineering or medicine
myths.fact: IB DP is accepted by universities for STEM, medicine, law, management — in India and worldwide. The subject combination is what matters, not the board.

myths.myth: IB means there are no exams
myths.fact: IB has rigorous external assessments. DP students sit comprehensive written exams marked by IB examiners worldwide — it is among the most respected qualifications globally.

myths.myth: IB does not prepare students for competitive exams
myths.fact: IB develops deep analytical thinking and strong academic foundations. FSK students successfully clear JEE, NEET, SAT, and other competitive examinations. Coaching for competitive exams is not discouraged — only tuition from former FS teachers is restricted.

admissions.heading: How admission to FSK works
admissions.subheading: The PAE process — three steps. Transparent, fair, centred on the child.

steps.title: Pre-Admission
steps.body: Initial enquiry and campus tour. Meet our admissions team to learn about our programmes, facilities, and the IB continuum. Walk through the campus on a school day — the best way to understand Fountainhead.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.body: Age-appropriate interaction or assessment. For younger grades, a warm play-based interaction. For older grades, a casual conversation with our academic team. We assess curiosity and enthusiasm — not just academics.

steps.title: Enrolment
steps.body: Offer of admission, documentation, fee payment, and welcome orientation. Your child joins the Fountainhead family — a lifelong community of learners, thinkers, and doers.

docsRequired: Last two years' academic report cards

studentLife.heading: Life at FSK
studentLife.sportsBody: FSK's Khelangan is built to international standards — featuring a football turf sourced from the Netherlands, cricket nets, basketball and pickleball courts, badminton facilities, and a gymnastics space.
studentLife.hdpBody: High-Performance Development programme for students with exceptional sporting talent — structured, competitive training alongside academic achievement.
